faq.question: Q1. What is the last date to apply for the IIT Gandhinagar Junior Research Fellow recruitment?
faq.answer: The last date to submit the application form for the Junior Research Fellow posts at IIT Gandhinagar is 25 September 2026.

faq.question: Q2. How many vacancies are available for the Junior Research Fellow position?
faq.answer: There are a total of 2 vacancies for the Junior Research Fellow position at IIT Gandhinagar.

faq.question: Q3. What is the educational qualification required for this post?
faq.answer: Candidates need a Post Graduate Degree in Basic Science or a Graduate/Post Graduate Degree in a Professional Course selected through NET/CSIR-UGC NET/GATE or equivalent national level examinations. A BTech/BE/MTech/ME in Electrical/Electronics/ECE/CSE or related disciplines with 60% is also accepted.

faq.question: Q4. What is the salary offered for the Junior Research Fellow role?
faq.answer: The selected candidates will receive a salary of Rs. 45,880 per month.

faq.question: Q5. Is there any application fee for this recruitment?
faq.answer: No, there is no application fee for General/OBC and SC/ST categories for this recruitment.

faq.question: Q6. What is the application mode for this recruitment?
faq.answer: The application mode for this recruitment is Online.

faq.question: Q7. What is the job type for the Junior Research Fellow position?
faq.answer: The job type for this position is Contractual.

faq.question: Q8. What is the selection process for the Junior Research Fellow posts?
faq.answer: The selection process involves shortlisting based on eligibility followed by an interview.

faq.question: Q9. Where can I find the official notification for this recruitment?
faq.answer: The official notification can be accessed through the Important Links section of this article, under the 'Official Notification PDF' link.

faq.question: Q10. Can I apply offline for this position?
faq.answer: No, applications must be submitted online only through the official IIT Gandhinagar website or the provided application link.
